html:
Buy a Ring Size Widget Online

You can add a ring‑sizer widget to your site for $12/month. The free version shows a “Powered by CaratBase” line; the Pro version removes it and lets you add a custom call‑to‑action button.

How to Get the Widget

  1. Visit the Widgets page.
  2. Select “Ring Sizer.”
  3. Choose the $12/month plan.
  4. Copy the short code that appears.
  5. Paste the code into any page of your website where you want the ring‑sizer to appear.

The widget can be used on any number of pages. Inquiries are routed to the contact details you provide on the site.

What You Receive

  • $12/month per domain.
  • No attribution line with the Pro version.
  • Custom call‑to‑action button.
  • The widget works on any page of your website.

FAQ

Do I need an account to use the widget? No. The widget itself does not require a user account.

Can I embed the widget on any page? Yes. The code works on any page of your website, regardless of platform.

Will the widget display my brand? With Widget Pro, the widget shows your logo and custom call‑to‑action, removing the “Powered by CaratBase” line.

Get your ring‑sizer widget today
